notes.title: Season 1 update East Amasia is now live!
notes.notes:
Hello Drifters!

 Thank you for your patience! The Northern and Southern Zones have been combined for experienced Drifters. Clear new requests to get a variety of rewards. Rise to new heights!

[previewyoutube=fTCUBjW_vQE;full][/previewyoutube]

In addition to the new map, Season 1 brings with it new Requests and a variety of rewards! Maintenance has ended with the following updates:
 

 East Amasia added. Unlocked with below quests. Once unlocked, you will only be able to sortie in East Amasia.
 Association Members: “Class A Drifter’s Final Exam”
 Black Market: “Permission to Sortie”
 New Requests added
 New Materials and Crafting Recipes added
 Adjustments and bug fixes to the online map
 Some enemy behavior and visuals adjusted
 Some game parameters adjusted for balance
 Other minor adjustments
 Bug fixes

① Players affected by an issue where their garage level resets after remodeling will also be compensated in the following ways: 

 Material and money used for the remodel will be given back
 Any SYNCOINS used for the affected upgrades will be returned
 Receive an additional 100,000 in currency
 
② Collected In-game Currency Related to the Magus Support Funds issues and Safe Pocket issues

 The amount collected from players who intentionally repeated the above actions will be reduced by a maximum of -99,000,000.
 All players who have played before the end of January maintenance will receive 200,000.
 
We look forward to your endeavor in East Amasia!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1245480/SYNDUALITY_Echo_of_Ada/

notes.title: Adjustments and Update for Season 1
notes.notes:
Hi Drifters, first of all, thank you to all the Association Members and Bounty Targets who have joined us in the world of SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada!

We are actively investigating and verifying reports of issues that some users may be experiencing since the servers have gone live. Please bear with us during this investigation so we can provide users with up to date information.

We have started addressing the value of in-game rewards, materials, and crafts, and will periodically adjust these rewards in a way that ensures a fun and progressive experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43879328/6777f2220fd93525154cb01866531f455479b81d.jpg

Upcoming Season 1 Update:
We will Introduce a new East Amasia Map, a massive new map that combines the Northern and Southern Zones for experienced Drifters! It won't be unlocked immediately; you'll need to progress your Requests to access it.

Future Plans:
We will adjust the price for certain CRADLECOFFIN parts to make it easier for new players to access lower rarity CRADLECOFFIN in a future update. Based on player data and feedback, an AO Crystal price adjustment has been done.

We hope for your continued support of SYNDUALITY Echo of Ada. Please look forward to more news and updates!
